content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stripe alternatives

Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle dominate digital commerce—but only where they choose to operate. For Nigerian creators, these platforms are off-limits. Workarounds like using VPNs or proxy accounts are temporary and risky. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, however, is permanent. It combines free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase with automatic crypto payment processing via NOWPayments. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints and templates for deployment. Unlike platforms, this infrastructure is owned by the creator, not rented. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. Full data ownership. It’s built to withstand payment rejection, currency collapse, and financial isolation—because it’s designed in Zimbabwe, where these aren’t hypothetical scenarios.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal exclude countries based on geopolitical risk, banking instability, and regulatory hurdles. Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle follow suit, as they rely on these payment processors. For Nigerian creators, this means no access to the tools that power 90% of global digital commerce. Sovereign infrastructure bypasses this entirely. It doesn’t depend on any single payment processor or platform. Crypto payments via NOWPayments are borderless, with no KYC requirements for buyers. The system works in every country, regardless of banking infrastructure. It’s not a workaround—it’s a structural alternative. Creators in restricted regions aren’t asking for permission; they’re deploying their own infrastructure.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal charge 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction, but Nigerian creators can’t access them. Crypto payments via NOWPayments charge 0.5% with no monthly fees. Recommended networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON keep transaction costs under $0.10. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) is a one-time purchase, with no recurring costs. Compare this to platforms that charge monthly fees, transaction fees, and app fees. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates middlemen. Payments confirm on-chain instantly, and the webhook triggers automatic product delivery. There’s no waiting for payouts—funds go directly to the creator’s wallet. The real cost is the initial deployment, but the infrastructure is then yours permanently.
Sovereign infrastructure is permanent—not a workaround.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Platforms like Gumroad and Paddle own your customer data, payment flow, and product delivery. If they shut down or change terms, your business is at risk. Sovereign infrastructure inverts this. The creator owns the hosting, backend logic, order storage, and file delivery. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your store. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders. Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver files. NOWPayments handles crypto payments. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all templates and blueprints for deployment. After setup, COREMERCH has no access—the creator owns everything. Automation is built into the stack: payment confirmation triggers instant product delivery. No manual intervention required.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re a Nigerian creator selling digital products, sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only permanent solution. It’s not for everyone—it requires initial setup. But the tradeoff is clear: you own the infrastructure, not the other way around. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides everything needed to deploy a fully operational stack. For creators who need faster deployment, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offer pre-built solutions. If you’re in a restricted country and serious about selling digital products, this is the architecture to choose. It’s built for creators who refuse to be locked out—and who want to own their commerce stack, not rent it.

What cryptocurrencies are supported?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transactions under $0.10.
Do I need to pay monthly fees?
No. The infrastructure uses free tools, and NOWPayments charges a one-time 0.5% fee per transaction. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) is a one-time purchase.
